title: 201 response to POST /v1/sites/{id}/checkout
description: 201 response to POST /v1/sites/{id}/checkout. The URL opens the Babilim checkout page at babilim.org in a new tab; the entry token is in the URL fragment and the plugin must open the URL unchanged. It stops working after expires_at (about 30 minutes) and is replaced by the next call, but an order already paid through it is still credited.
